signal: Windfall closed a $65M Series B led by Morgan Stanley Expansion Capital and launched an AI Copilot and Market Insights for its 1,500+ data-driven customers

email.body1:
Matt, saw Windfall close its $65M Series B and ship the AI Copilot and Market Insights.

Growth that fast usually means more in-market nonprofits in play than an enterprise team can cover before they cool, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Windfall off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Matt, quick follow-up for Windfall.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and recovering it becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Windfall's enterprise nonprofit segment needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Matt, last bit of proof for Windfall.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Windfall's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Matt, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and the post-Series-B stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise nonprofit motion? I'll tailor it to Windfall either way.
